steps: Find an ADMA BioCenters location and schedule
Bring valid ID, proof of address, and SSN
Pass screening and physical exam on first visit (2-3 hours)
Donate up to twice per week; return-visit pay is weight-tiered
Refer friends via the Buddy Bonus form — $75 paid on-site once they donate twice

who_pays: ADMA BioCenters pays you onto a Paysign Visa prepaid card — a reloadable cash card issued at your first donation, with funds auto-transferred after each successful donation.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring a valid ID, proof of address, and SSN — then pass the medical screening and physical. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: ADMA is a small regional chain with about 7 FDA-licensed centers in GA, TN, SC, and NC — it's only usable if you're near one of them. New-donor first-month bonuses have cooled from their peaks, so confirm your center's current offer before visiting.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations only — pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. The $75 Buddy Bonus pays only after your referred friend donates twice.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit takes 2-3 hours with screening and physical before any pay; return visits run about 90-180 minutes. A needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips, travel and waiting — all unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Money is available right away: after each successful donation your pay is automatically transferred to your reloadable Paysign Visa card.
